name: Potrero Center
summary: Potrero Center is a 226,642 square foot power center in San Francisco's Mission District, anchored by Safeway, Ross Dress For Less, 24 Hour Fitness, and Petco. With over 3.2 million annual visits, this well-positioned shopping destination serves one of the city's most affluent neighborhoods with convenient access to groceries, fitness, and everyday retail needs.
demographics: Potrero Center serves one of San Francisco's most affluent trade areas, with households within 3 miles averaging $207,616 in annual income and home values of $1.5 million. The daytime population of 844,348 significantly exceeds the residential population of 546,576, indicating a strong influx of workers and visitors to the Mission District area. The center attracts a diverse, urban demographic including young professionals, families, and long-time San Francisco residents who value convenience and quality in their everyday shopping needs.
description: Potrero Center is a prominent power center strategically located at 2300 16th Street in San Francisco's vibrant Mission District, offering exceptional visibility from three major thoroughfares. Spanning 226,642 square feet, this well-established shopping destination serves as a vital retail hub for one of the city's most dynamic neighborhoods. The center is anchored by essential retailers including Safeway, Ross Dress For Less, 24 Hour Fitness, and Petco, complemented by a carefully curated mix of service providers and dining options such as Peet's Coffee & Tea, Jamba Juice, and Noah's New York Bagels. With over 3.2 million annual visits, Potrero Center has become an indispensable part of daily life for San Francisco residents, offering convenient access to groceries, fitness, pet supplies, and everyday necessities. The property's location in the heart of the Mission provides easy access to a trade area characterized by exceptional affluence, with average household incomes exceeding $207,000 and a substantial daytime population of over 844,000 workers and visitors.
